title: Introducing our FY26 integrated annual report
summary: Clorox’s FY26 integrated annual report highlights a pivotal transition year, including the GOJO acquisition, U.S. ERP implementation, strategic progress and the company’s focus on long-term profitable growth.
body_markdown:
**By Linda Rendle, Chair and Chief Executive Officer**


*Read the full letter and Clorox’s complete FY26 integrated annual report*[here](https://www.thecloroxcompany.com/annualreport) *.*


Today we released our fiscal year 2026 integrated annual report, documenting a pivotal transition year for Clorox. Amid a challenging consumer and macroeconomic environment, we took decisive actions to strengthen our business, enhance our ability to serve consumers, sharpen execution, and position the company for long-term growth and value creation.


During the year, we achieved several transformative milestones, including the acquisition of GOJO Industries and the implementation of our U.S. enterprise resource planning, or ERP, system. Together these actions advanced our strategy and strengthened our portfolio, capabilities, and ways of working that will support more consistent, profitable growth over time.


#### Living our values as a responsible business remains fundamental to how we champion people to be well and thrive every single day.


As we look ahead, we remain focused on driving profitable category growth and creating long-term shareholder value. While we expect consumers to remain value-conscious as inflation, cost volatility, and uncertainty continue to influence purchasing decisions, they continue to seek trusted brands that deliver on-trend benefits, performance, and convenience. With a stronger innovation pipeline, a healthier portfolio, and a clear roadmap to win with consumers, we enter fiscal year 2027 focused on delivering superiority through innovation and investing behind our brands while generating fuel for reinvestment.


To our teammates around the world: thank you for your commitment, resilience, and focus throughout the year. Your dedication to serving consumers and customers, advancing our strategic priorities, and supporting one another continues to be one of Clorox’s greatest strengths. And to our investors, customers, suppliers, and partners: thank you for your trust and partnership as we continue to build a stronger, more resilient company for the future.
